   - **<missing 8>:** Investigating \( g(j) \), "<expression 6> g(j)=f(n+j)-f(n)=(n+j-1)m-(n-1)m=jm".
   - **<missing 9>:** Likely related to the constant term or initialization, "<expression 9> n=0".
   - **<missing 10>:** \( f(1)=0 \) and its equation characterization "<expression 4> f(1)=m+b=0".
   - **<missing 11>:** Expresses \( g(j) \), aligns with "<expression 20> g(j)=a_{1}+f(n+j)-a_{n}=a_{1}+f(n+j)-a_{1}-f(n)".
   - **<missing 12>:** Representation of \( f(n) \) as a linear equation "<expression 15> f(n)=mn+b".
   - **<missing 13>:** Expression of intercept in terms of only \( m \), "<expression 21> b=-m".
   - **<missing 14>:** Contextual with \( f(1) \) being 0 as stated "<expression 4> f(1)=m+b=0".
   - **<missing 15>:** Consistently tying with above, "<expression 21> b=-m".
   - **<missing 16>:** Linear function without intercept, "<expression 19> f(n)=mn-m=(n-1)m".
   - **<missing 17>:** Restriction condition for non-negativity "<expression 23> \forall m\geq 0 \mid m \in \mathbb{Z}".
   - **<missing 18>:** Continuation of polynomial property, "<expression 14> a_{n}+g(j)=a_{n+j}=a_{1}+f(n+j)".
   - **<missing 19>:** Final derivation of the main function, "<expression 24> a_{n}=a_{1}+(n-1)m".
   - **<missing 20>:** Condition \( m \geq 0 \), "<expression 3> m\geq 0 \mid m \in \mathbb{Z}".
   - **<missing 21>:** Referring to polynomial \( P \) as indicated earlier, "<expression 7> P(a_{n})".
   - **<missing 22>:** Stating condition of increasing or constant \( f(n) \), "<expression 12> a_{1} \geq 1 \mid a_{1} \in \mathbb{Z}".
   - **<missing 23>:** Setting the initial term, "<expression 16> a_{1}=a_{1}+f(1)".
   - **<missing 24>:** Restating \( a_n \) for general conditions, "<expression 1> a_{n+1}=a_{1}+f(n+1)".

In conclusion, the logical mapping of expressions to the missing parts are well aligned in explanation and sequence context.
